actual_verification_scope.fixture_scope: Original map and Hint actions using four temporary clue bits in a copied Syracuse save.

artifact_lore.context: The clue document describes the artifact in an inscription. The native view chooses this field with the second document index. Preserve the distinction between an asserted property and a legend about it.

sea_region.context: The clue document gives a sea-region lead using the first document index. Some maps identify where the treasure lies. Others give the waters to depart from before following the direction clue.

direction.context: The clue document gives a direction using the same index as the sea-region lead. Its distance and orientation qualify that lead. A relative position and an instruction to travel serve different functions.

cross_instruction.context: The clue document tells the player to search the location marked with an X when this field is visible.
